establishes: A complete, published and mechanically validated Study 4F instrument exists: separate single-family D2 and D3 banks with an exact answer-label allocation, two fully frozen decoding contracts, exactly sixteen Bonferroni cells at alpha_per_cell = 1/320, and a candidate-local ladder.

The registered unquantized single-accelerator route for the 32B checkpoint could not be proven on this host: no accelerator was visible and 64.73 GiB would be required for weights, the maximum registered KV cache and the fixed safety reserve.
No prohibited fallback was taken: no quantization, no sharding, no CPU or disk offload, no device_map='auto' and no unregistered model substitution.
does_not_establish: Nothing about whether any registered checkpoint has generated-CoT task headroom on D2 or on D3, because no cell was executed.
Nothing about whether any registered checkpoint shows zero-generated-reasoning-token expressed competence, because no E0 cell was executed.
Nothing about whether a natural positive-reference candidate exists in the registered ladder, because the ladder was never run.
Nothing about whether J-space exists, is observable or is unobservable; Study 4F never tested any of these and could not have.
Nothing about whether the raw direct-answer interface is valid or invalid, because it was never exercised against a model.
Nothing that generalizes beyond the registered checkpoints, depths and interface, because there is no result to generalize.

next_action_rule.statement: Study 4F stops at the registered section 4 state. Resuming requires one accelerator that can hold the 32B checkpoint, the maximum registered KV cache and the fixed safety reserve without offloading; the published instrument may then be reused unchanged from the shakedown step. Quantizing, sharding or offloading to proceed is prohibited and would not be the registered study.
